message:
Simplify K215 recursion, quotient syntax and dense halting proofs

Share transfinite recursion and hypothesis-free quotient syntax; extract the exact PowerSets boundary. Adopt Source193's one-step-later dense invariant and explicitly import Completeness where KQ1ZF already used it. Preserve theorem hypotheses and external endpoint types.

Nine Lean sources save11,809bytes/283lines. The reproduced six-output quotient producer adds1,307bytes/12lines; combined maintenance saves10,502bytes/271lines. Endpoint178→176projectmodules, with five decoder-prefix modules.

Validation:194primary providers (45fresh records across19+25+1 successful calls;149phase14 reuses), two unchanged endpoint audits,71compatibility providers (6fresh/54primary/11phase14),199distinct projects. All62API,10endpoint and10compatibility client reports pass with recorded standard profiles;6176site outcomes remain exact inherited checks. Both isolated producer controls reproduce all six outputs.

Preserve both failed primary attempts and exact bounded resumes, and the first failed metadata capture. Corrected capture and owner/independent saved --repo readers pass with identical receipts;8core packet bytes remain unchanged. Sources193–194 are separately intaken and catalogued; residual and scheduler proposals are not promoted.

The exact upstream quotient sources/producer retain three extra EOF blank lines; the whitespace receipt records them. No new Rocq run, machine change, internal PA/ZFC derivation or goal completion is claimed.

K215 Lean: one bisimulation quotient, CP/GIC through a QHyp adapter

Lands the proposal proposals/quotient-unification (the peer's checkpoint cd67e7bade adopted its base, the shared quotient syntax). The KQ1* development over KQHyp.QHyp is the only quotient construction; QuotientModel.ofCPGIC derives all nine QHyp fields from an inhabited CP/GIC model, and QuotientModel / QuotientSeparation / QuotientBasic / QuotientPower / QuotientReplacement and the collection half of QuotientCPGIC state the KQ1 results at that structure under their original names and statements. The KQ1 files are maintained source; generate_kq1.py is retired. Every name used in Lean or cited in the repository's records is kept; only helpers cited nowhere are dropped.

Checked: serial per-module lake build of the 25 up-to-date modules of the reverse closure of KQHyp/KQ1Model, from KQHyp to KEndpoint, all green. Not rebuilt here (left to the full rebuild): KEndpoint21x, the 240-254 endpoints, WFTheory, ProgramZF0 and the facade.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Lean: decoder trees computed from their programs, not written out

Every K-family source module wrote the tree of its source program and of its target path DAG out as one literal line (t215/tD, t217/tD, t218/tD, t219/tD, t221/tD, t225/t230), then proved tX_eq : ptree pX = tX by rfl, so the kernel recomputed each tree anyway. They are now def tX : Tree := ptree pX; names and statements are unchanged, and the six source generators emit the same. Lands proposals/computed-tree and extends it to tD and the 217-225 sources: 1,493,199 bytes of literals removed across seven files (KSource215Program 129,741 -> 6,867; KSource215Data 239,254 -> 116,343; KSource217/218/219/221 ~650 KB -> ~405 KB each; KSource225 598,391 -> 333,311). Also fixes the 217 and 218 docstrings, which called their own trees the 219's.

Checked here: KSource215Program, KSource215Data (35 s) and KSource215FwdCheck00 (5.7 s) build; earlier, KSites215Batch004 185 s -> 202 s, DecoderSourceBinding and KDecoderPrefix215 green. The other K215 certificate chunks and site batches and the 217-225 sources are left to the full rebuild.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Lean: the 215 and 217 enumerators compile C222 directly

Lands the Lean component of proposals/proof-fusion and applies it to EnumDom too. build interprets the restricted dominated-implication theorem DomRho8.rho8_all_of_restricted in the predicate fun n => exists p, Contract p n: closure under modus ponens is mp_contract and the restricted rho8 rows are the existing leaves, so every C222 derivation compiles without first translating it into the dominated calculus CDom. KCodeDom (and its cdom_of_c222) leaves both endpoint closures; it stays as a library module stating CDom = C222, which records cite. The old CDom-typed build had no other users, so no compatibility module is added. Endpoint docstrings updated.

Checked: lake build of EnumPerm, L2AxiomsPerm, L2RootPerm, SeedPerm, EnumDom, L2AxiomsDom, L2RootDom, SeedDom, one at a time, all green; dagPerm_seed_iff and dagDom_seed_iff keep [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. KEndpoint215/217 are left to the full rebuild (docstring-only change there).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Rocq: one shared implication core for CD222 and DomRho8 in the 215, 217, 218 and 221

Lands the Rocq proposal of 1d7e78a487 (rho8cd/rocq-proposal/shared-core). DominatedCore.v (rocq224/src) is the generic Section from the 58-step condensed-detachment derivation: any connective imp, any reflexive below closed under insertion into either operand, modus ponens and the restricted rows derive rho8_all, composition, lift_right, K, Peirce and S. CD222 is the core at below := True over thm222 (same thm_K, thm_P, thm_B, thm_S); DomRho8 is the core at natural codes with <= (same DomImp record and rho8_all). Both are copied into every variant by the regenerate scripts, which now list DominatedCore before CD222.

Removed: the 107 ported CD254 certificates in each CD222 (22,865 bytes -> 1.4 KB, four copies), the 217's 921,672-byte reflective DomRho8 replay and the 215's 22,673-byte compact one, their renderers generate_domrho8_rocq.py and generate_domrho8_rocq_compact.py, and rocqdom/DomRho8Reflection.v. 26 files, +1,539 -28,612 lines.

Regenerated all four variants with regenerate221/218/217/215.py against a K230 reference whose manifest has the pinned hash bbd4694416...; before the change the same runs reproduced the committed coq/2xx trees byte for byte, and after it only CD222, DomRho8, the new DominatedCore and the receipts changed. manifest.json refreshed: ten pins plus the four new files, DominatedCore inserted before CD222 in each compile order; no pin was stale before. Compiled with Rocq 9.1.0 (rocq91b) one coqc at a time: 215 DominatedCore..ThmDom, 217 Codes222..ThmDom, 218 and 221 Codes222..Complete222, every Print Assumptions closed. Not run here: the rest of each variant's compile order and recursive coqchk (left to the full rebuild).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

K215 Rocq: normalized one-sided source certificate

Re-lands 5a09be9b09 (reverted at the peer's checkpoint), on top of the shared implication core. The source/dagPerm correspondence is checked modulo the implicit false suffix of pointers: 1,426 certificate entries instead of 2,240, checked in one direction only, with BisimMirror giving the reverse from the same check. OffsetBisim230.v and the 1.5 MB Cert215Offsets.v leave the 215's closure; Source215.p215_dagPerm keeps its exact statement. Source layer 1,507,824 -> 122,314 bytes. Hand-written modules in k225-formal/rocqperm/ (PathCodec, BisimMirror, NormalizedBisim), data in inputs/215/NormalizedCert215.v; regenerate215.py copies them and emits the one-check Source215.v, and coq/215 regenerates byte for byte.

The add_variant21x.py registrations now list DominatedCore before CD222 (the 218/221 scripts are one-time registrations whose build.py preconditions no longer hold; only their lists change); add_variant215.py re-registered the 215 and refreshed its pins, add_variant217.py reproduced the manifest unchanged.

Checked with Rocq 9.1.0 (rocq91b), one coqc at a time, against the compiled K230 reference: the complete 215 compile order, DominatedCore through CorrectDense215, all green, both endpoint files closed under the global context. Recursive coqchk not run here.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Lean: the AX words list macros only; successors come from the program

Lands the local alternative of proposals/proof-boundaries (lean/local.patch). The checked macro word of L2AxiomsPerm and L2AxiomsDom stored (macro, successor) pairs, but the successor is already the literal program's: axWordCheck now reads it from dagPerm.nodes n / dagDom.nodes n, rejecting a non-node pair, a mismatched macro, or an end other than the gate 457, and the same run induction gives the contract. 156 redundant successor numbers leave each word: L2AxiomsPerm 7,563 -> 6,533 bytes, L2AxiomsDom likewise; generate_l2axiomsdom.py renders both (outputs reproduced byte for byte).

Checked: lake build of L2AxiomsPerm, L2RootPerm, SeedPerm, L2AxiomsDom, L2RootDom, SeedDom, one at a time, all green; l236, ax_eval and the seed theorems keep [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

K215 Lean: the full seed directly on the original model

Lands the Lean component of proposals/direct-seed-shared-rules (implementing the earlier DIRECT_FULL_SEED.md plan, after Complete222.v's fresh-code construction). c222_complete's derivability premise interprets codes through th while the model is of the original named formulas, so FullSeed holds directly on the original domain: for a named formula psi take the matrix not-not-psi and the private container name enc (th m), which is not free in m and exceeds 1 (KSeedDirect222.seed_direct, fullSeed_direct_of_derivable). KEndpoint uses it with the original-domain witness.

The preliminary route through equality-free matrices and the indiscernibility quotient is gone: KSeedModel222 and KIndisc222 had no other importers and are deleted; their shared definitions (named bundle syntax, DerivableNF, KIndisc222.FullSeed) moved unchanged to KSeedInterface222. Net -59 lines; one module fewer in every K endpoint's closure. README lower-chain row updated.

Checked: lake build of KSeedInterface222, KSeedDirect222, KLowerSeed, KEndpoint, one at a time, green; seed_direct and fullSeed_direct_of_derivable report [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. KEndpoint21x left to the full rebuild.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

K215 Rocq: the compiler compiles thm222 directly; ThmDom leaves the 215

Lands the Rocq component of proposals/proof-fusion (the twin of the Lean change). Compilable X := exists L, blk X L is a DomImp instance (blk_true, blk_mp, the guarded blk_r8), so rho8_all gives a block for every unrestricted rho8 row, and L1_CompPerm.compile_direct inducts on thm222 itself instead of first translating to the dominated calculus thmDom. SeedPerm uses it. ThmDom then has no client in the 215 and is no longer generated there (regenerate215.py, add_variant215.py); it stays for the 217's own compiler. Compiler 351 -> 362 lines, ThmDom's 70 lines gone; the four enum/seed endpoint theorem types are unchanged.

Regenerated the 215 against the pinned-manifest K230 reference (reproduces the patched templates exactly) and re-registered it (44 proof files). Compiled with Rocq 9.1.0 one coqc at a time: L1_CompPerm through CorrectDense215, all green, both endpoint files closed under the global context.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

K215 Rocq: BisimMirror folded into NormalizedBisim

BisimMirror.v proved the mirror lemmas for the pinned plain checker
(K230P.Bisim230.branch_ok/entry_ok/check) plus three helpers. Since
the normalized certificate, the 215 uses only NCheck's checker
(Source215 calls NCheck.check_one_sided_iff), so the plain-checker
half was dead; the three helpers NCheck uses (flip_plain,
cnt_eq_mirror, getc_mirror) now sit at the top of NormalizedBisim.v
and BisimMirror.v is gone from rocqperm/ and coq/215 (43 proof files,
was 44). NCheck.entry_ok_mirror closes its three conjuncts with one
`repeat split; [.. | .. ..]`, and check_one_sided_iff with one split.
regenerate215.py and add_variant215.py drop the file; coq/215
regenerated against the pinned K230 reference, manifest re-registered.

Checked: coqc of the regenerated NormalizedBisim, Source215,
Correct215 and CorrectDense215 against the compiled K230 reference,
all "Closed under the global context". The research proposals under
verification/k215/simplification/ that mention BisimMirror are
historical and left as they are.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

disp_1/disp_2 and disp_drop/disp_mp were proved by the same tactic
script twice each, differing only in the node numbers of their
statements (the reflexivity steps check different node-table rows), so
the scripts are now the local tactics disp_pos and disp_zero
(146 -> 138 lines; +40 -57 with the generated copy, net -17).
coq/215 regenerated against the pinned K230 reference and the manifest
re-registered.

against the compiled K230 reference, all "Closed under the global
context".

K215 Rocq: drop the unused s0-based enumerator theorems

The 215's completeness and soundness run from the bootstrap seed
(SeedPerm.seedPerm_iff_thm, used by MainPerm), whose reach_from and
halts_from_reached are the seed-general versions of L1_CompPerm's
reach/halts_from_reach. The s0-based layer was never used:
- EnumPerm.v: s0 and enum_halts;
- L1_SoundPerm.v: Inv_s0 and enum_sound;
- L1_CompPerm.v: reach, halts_from_reach and enum_complete.
All are removed (rocqperm 513 -> 470 lines over the three files;
+22 -108 with the generated copies, net -86), and the two file headers
now say what the files prove. coq/215 regenerated against the pinned
K230 reference and the manifest re-registered.

Checked: coqc of the compile-order slice EnumPerm .. MainPerm (EnumPerm,
L1_SoundPerm, L1_CompPerm, SeedPerm, Regs215, DagPerm, ProgLibPerm,
L2RootPerm, MainPerm) and of Correct215 and CorrectDense215 against the
compiled K230 reference, all "Closed under the global context".
